content.title: Zendaya shares a terrible secret with Robert Pattinson in 'The Drama' trailer
content.text: by Sabra Satz-KojisTue, February 3, 2026 at 2:00 PMNEW YORK, NEW YORK - DECEMBER 02: Zendaya attends The Gothams 34th Annual Film Awards at Cipriani Wall Street on December 02, 2024 in New York City. (Photo by Theo Wargo/Getty Images)True love may not be able to conquer all in Zendaya and Robert Pattinson’s new movie, “The Drama.”Zendaya poses for photographers upon arrival at the premiere of the film 'Challengers' on Wednesday, April 10, 2024 in London. (Photo by Vianney Le Caer/Invision/AP)In the trailer for the upcoming A24 film, an engaged couple struggles to move past an unexpected revelation the week before their wedding.Zendaya plays Emma Harwood, a woman who works at a publishing house and is madly in love for the first time with British museum director Charlie Thompson, played by Pattinson.PARIS, FRANCE - JUNE 27: (EDITORIAL USE ONLY - For Non-Editorial use please seek approval from Fashion House) Robert Pattinson attends the Dior Homme Menswear Spring/Summer 2026 show as part of Paris Fashion Week on June 27, 2025 in Paris, France. (Photo by Francois Durand/Getty Images)In the trailer, the couple’s friends, played by Alana Haim and Mamoudou Athie, encourage Emma and Charlie to play a game in which each must share the worst thing they’ve ever done. Although their answers are omitted from the trailer, Emma’s answer is clearly catastrophic, hurting her relationships with both her friends and with Charlie.Later, Emma encourages her fiancé to forget the information, saying, “You have to stop thinking about it.” Charlie replies, “You can’t just say, ‘stop thinking about it,’” and admits he’s thinking about her secret in that moment.250 truckloads of food delivered to all 50 states for America250Throughout the trailer, Emma and Charlie struggle to repair their own relationship and their friendships, all while their wedding is just days away.NEW YORK, NEW YORK - DECEMBER 02: Zendaya attends The Gothams 34th Annual Film Awards at Cipriani Wall Street on December 02, 2024 in New York City. (Photo by Theo Wargo/Getty Images)“The Drama” was written and directed by Kristoffer Borgli, a Norwegian filmmaker known for his previous A24 movie, “Dream Scenario,” which earned Nicolas Cage a Golden Globe nomination.The film is scheduled to premiere in theaters on April 3, just nine days before Zendaya’s Emmy-winning HBO series “Euphoria” returns for season three.
